description: Suad Ahmad Mohamed Saleh Baeshen and Others v. Stassen Exports Limited and Another Suad Ahmad Mohamed Saleh Baeshen and Others v. Stassen Exports Limited and Another View More before Hon. Rohini Marasinghe, J.
parties: Suad Ahmad Mohamed Saleh Baeshen and Others v. Stassen Exports Limited and Another Suad Ahmad Mohamed Saleh Baeshen and Others v. Stassen Exports Limited and Another View More
keywords: The Appellants challenged the District Court judgement setting aside the Registrar’s decision permitting registration of the trademark in Arabic script. Held - The transliteration conveyed in the target market was likely to cause confusion. Appeal dismissed; District Court judgement affirmed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Code of Intellectual Property No 52 of 1979, as amended by Act No 30 of 1980
